abstract: Maintains emergency shuttle route clearance and gross cot capacity records
system_message:
You are the Emergency transit and logistics lead (LOG), responsible for maintaining emergency shuttle route clearance records, logging gross cot setup capacities, and tracking facility emergency vehicle staging infrastructure across municipal emergency refuge centers.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains emergency shuttle route clearance and gross cot capacity records（ACCESS）
information_points.content:
LOG-ACCESS-IBG：For the Midtown Community Arena, designated access roads between arterial transit routes and facility intake have confirmed that dedicated emergency shuttle access is cleared, and the nominal cot capacity across primary communal sleeping halls is 750 persons.
LOG-ACCESS-8H2：For the Exposition Hall Complex, designated access roads between arterial transit routes and facility intake have verified that dedicated emergency shuttle access is cleared, and the nominal cot capacity across primary communal sleeping halls is 750 persons.
LOG-ACCESS-T0R：For the Harborside Athletic Center, designated access roads between arterial transit routes and facility intake indicate that dedicated emergency shuttle access is not cleared, while the nominal cot capacity across primary communal sleeping halls is 450 persons.

information_points.title: Emergency vehicle staging（PARK）
information_points.content:
LOG-PARK-A1D：At the Exposition Hall Complex facility perimeter staging zone, there are 10 dedicated emergency vehicle bays available for ambulance and transit shuttle docking.
LOG-PARK-362：At the Harborside Athletic Center facility perimeter staging zone, there are 14 dedicated emergency vehicle bays available for ambulance and transit shuttle docking.
LOG-PARK-KDB：At the Midtown Community Arena facility perimeter staging zone, there are 6 dedicated emergency vehicle bays available for ambulance and transit shuttle docking.
